body:
Registered `place_pose` could publish a correct caller-selected pose without a provenance row, while an undeclared externally staged candidate could bypass destination authorization. Final publication now checks the armed destination before mutation and records the accepted written board, including snapped coordinates, rotations, faces and lock state. Placement decisions and engineering gates remain unchanged.

Closes #960

Depends on #968. Inherited published parent: **cbc819b6b862f6ec14ecb30b8659819e800fce76**, fetched from `edgehero:fix/967-resolved-edge-clearance` after checking GitHub. #968 remains open. This NEW PR targets upstream **main**, so its main-based diff includes the parent commits. [Parent-head-to-candidate comparison isolating #960](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/compare/cbc819b6b862f6ec14ecb30b8659819e800fce76...bae72deee7ef90a5e27618c23424c27293c88b72).

Final verified head: **bae72deee7ef90a5e27618c23424c27293c88b72**. All three independent reviewers confirmed that its production, test and fixture trees exactly match behavior-tested **4d7d2947d4af3d91c66f5680a535e06e75f7d841**. Existing worktrees, original fixtures and #968's branch were preserved.

- Shared publication covers the pose setter, direct placement writer, reconstruction promotion, seed output after lock stamping, seed/reconstruction repair writes and route-loop final delivery. Final snapshots record parent/candidate/written SHA, poses, faces and locks. Rejected pose trials and dry runs do not become committed ledger rows.
- Registered execution and coordinate selection are distinct: `applied_by=place_pose.py`, `decision_source=caller`, with an explicit model declaration supported when supplied. Ordinary adapters outside benchmark regimes remain available. In-place baseline writes preserve original bytes and requirement siblings and retarget the manifest without changing the baseline SHA.
- Cooperating publishers and audits serialize through publication locks. Catchable failures attempt board/sibling/manifest/ledger rollback; duplicate pending records refuse and cancelled trials do not poison retries. Failed recovery and postcommit cleanup failures disclose actual state and retain evidence. Legacy rows cannot certify a changed lock or face they never recorded.

[Committed commands, identities, emitted ledger rows, audit results and native geometry evidence](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/bae72deee7ef90a5e27618c23424c27293c88b72/docs/issue-960-evidence/README.md):

- **Reproduction reviewer:** independently reproduced both failures on the published parent with real `stage_unaided.py` and `provenance_audit.py`. The exact esp_prog `set R1 136.4 98.8 --rot 270` control still writes that native pose without force, at .25/.55 mm clearance. Conflicts remain 83 -> 72 and shortfall 27.1331 -> 22.5783 mm. Before: zero rows, audit 4/R1 unclaimed. After: one final-SHA snapshot, audit CLEAN. `no_worse=true, legal=false` remains explicit. Fresh and existing undeclared destination promotions refuse before mutation.
- **Transaction reviewer:** independently exercised ledger rename failures before/after the actual syscall, existing-ledger restoration, pending-install interruption, true process death, concurrent writers, audit-read contention, deep regimes, native F/B flips, lock-only drift, cleanup failures and denied recovery. Found the alternate reconstruction bypass during review; it was fixed and all affected probes rerun. Recovery mutation independently killed, with clean worktree restoration.
- **Final placement reviewer:** **124 assertions across 41 real CLI invocations** on the integrated final revision, with native board/ledger reconciliation for direct poses, rotation, directional face operations, locks/unlocks, strict snap, coordinated moves, atomic refusal, both in-place forms, all requirement siblings and fixed mechanics. Actual seed, reconstruction and route-loop delivery checks pass within their recorded scopes.
- **Focused regression commands: 21 passed**, including 11 transaction tests, 65 provenance assertions, 134 pose assertions, 11 edge tests, native geometry parity, both routing parity gates and all 1,108 mutation anchors. Documentation examples: 32 runnable blocks pass, 78 fragments skipped. Two historical reconstruction files skip 4 and 9 tests respectively because untracked tigard fixtures are absent; their remaining assertions and separate public-board CLI controls pass.

Limits: these are cooperating filesystem transactions, not atomic multi-file visibility to arbitrary readers, a security boundary against raw copying/forged declarations, automatic crash recovery or a power-loss/network-filesystem guarantee. A terminated publication leaves a marker and evidence: audit is UNPROVEN and later writers refuse until manual reconciliation. If ledger restoration itself is denied, an unresolved candidate row can remain alongside a restored board; the retained marker prevents certifying it as a successful result. No consistent-ledger guarantee is claimed when recovery fails. Full-suite, full-board DRC/connectivity, PCB quality and model-performance gains are not claimed. Parent #968's documented geometry/custom-rule coverage limits remain intact.
title: Guard final pose publication and reconcile provenance (#960)
